svg.title: One NuGet package, separate internal modules
svg.desc: AvaVideoPlayer.nupkg embeds the control, engine, interop, FFmpeg, platforms, Skia and browser assemblies; browser assets; native runtime libraries for five desktop runtime identifiers; and licenses and corresponding source materials. Avalonia remains an external dependency.
svg.text: One install. NuGet selects the matching framework and runtime assets.
BrowserVideoBackend in the browser target framework
Separate assemblies, embedded in this single package
License, notices and corresponding native sources
Common original archives stored once; profile-specific bridge source and build recipes retained.
The included materializer reconstructs the exact original source/build tree for each runtime.
External NuGet dependencies: Avalonia / Avalonia.Skia (desktop), Avalonia / Avalonia.Browser (browser)
